title: Ushiro Shishou
body:
Syntax: perform ushiro shishou <target>

Description: A level 30 Ninjutsu opening strike. Sneak up on an unhurt target before combat starts for increased damage. It costs chakra and cannot be used mid-fight or against an already hurt target. Hidden Mist improves your chance to land the opening strike but does not lift either restriction.

Date: 2026-09-26
